description: 8.4A.2 - a renamed limit keeps enforcing until its window closes, so renaming cannot reset an allowance.

requests.note: 80.00 reserved. Both legs are under the 50.00 threshold, so neither escalates on amount.
petty_cash_v2 has a fresh 100.00, but the retired petty_cash still holds 80.00 of its own. 80 + 20 is exactly 100, so this is the last thing the rename permits.
The retired limit is now full, and 8.3 takes the most restrictive. Without 8.4A.2 the rename would have handed the agent a fresh 100.00 mid-month.
